purpose: Life-cycle inventory database for the superstructure, joined on Case ID.
status: skeleton written 2026-09-20; inventory values are empty until the process simulation produces them or a background database is cited.

impact_categories.how_to_obtain: IPCC AR6 GWP100 factors; state the version and whether biogenic carbon is separated. N2O matters here: the engine cases emit it and its factor is large.

impact_categories.characterisation_source: ijlca2019-impact-world (or ReCiPe; pick one and state the region)
impact_categories.how_to_obtain: NH3 slip and NOx from the simulation multiplied by regionalized factors
same flows as acidification; the regional factor spread is one to two orders of magnitude, so the region has to be declared

foreground_flows_from_simulation.from: Aspen case result; the process database holds measured ranges (P037-P041)
Aspen case result after the S7 train
Aspen case result after the S7 train

foreground_flows_from_simulation.flow: stack, catalyst and membrane replacement mass
foreground_flows_from_simulation.from: TEA replacement intervals times component mass; needs the mass, which is not collected yet

background_data_needed.note: five production routes read from jert2023-nh3-production-lca; a second source (ijer2022-carrier-lca) gives a different value for the PV route, so the spread is real and belongs in the scenario axis

background_data_needed.how_to_obtain: distance-based shipping inventory; state the route and the boil-off assumption
background database plus a published stack bill of materials
port grid mix for the declared region

jert2023-nh3-production-lca.title: Life cycle assessment of selected ammonia production technologies from the perspective of ammonia as a fuel for heavy-duty vehicle
jert2023-nh3-production-lca.read: Climate change per 1 MJ (LHV) of ammonia: grey 0.148, blue 0.0701, green PV 0.0197, green wind 0.01039, pink 0.00565 kg CO2-eq, against diesel 0.0851 kg CO2-eq including stoichiometric combustion. ReCiPe, GaBi with Sphera Managed LCA Content.
jert2023-nh3-production-lca.use: the upstream ammonia intensity this study's GWP result is most sensitive to; five production routes give the scenario axis the paper plans

ijer2022-carrier-lca.title: LCA comparison analysis for two types of H2 carriers: methanol and ammonia
ijer2022-carrier-lca.read: Full supply chain including production, storage, transport and utilisation; solar PV ammonia has the lowest GWP at 43.9 g CO2-eq per MJ of ammonia; electricity is the key sensitivity.
ijer2022-carrier-lca.use: an independent value for the same quantity (0.0439 kg CO2-eq/MJ against 0.0197 above), which is the spread the scenario analysis has to carry

ijlca2019-impact-world.title: IMPACT World+: a globally regionalized life cycle impact assessment method
ijlca2019-impact-world.read: A midpoint-damage framework; GWP100 complemented by GTP100 for long-term climate impact, and regionalized categories including acidification and eutrophication, whose characterization factors vary by one to two orders of magnitude between regions.
ijlca2019-impact-world.use: the characterization method for the acidification and eutrophication categories the plan adds next to GWP100, and the reason a regionalized factor must be stated, not assumed

ecm2026-nh3-power-lca.title: Advancing conventional power systems: life cycle assessment of ammonia-based decarbonization
ecm2026-nh3-power-lca.use: named in the paper plan; no abstract in the indexes used here, so read the paper before citing

recipe2016.title: ReCiPe2016: a harmonised life cycle impact assessment method at midpoint and endpoint level
recipe2016.read: Life cycle impact assessment translates emissions and resource extractions into a limited number of impact scores through characterisation factors, derived at midpoint or endpoint level; the paper updates ReCiPe2008.
recipe2016.use: 특성화 계수 출처 후보 — 중간지표(midpoint) 기준으로 GWP·산성화·부영양화를 한 방법으로 묶을 때

open_questions: Which background database the study will use, and whether it is available (the two studies read here both used GaBi/Sphera content).
Whether ammonia transport is inside the boundary; the plan says 'as far as possible', which is not a boundary a reviewer can check.
Whether N2O is reported with AR6 or AR5 factors; the difference is visible in an ammonia engine.

method_equations.name: 경계 분해
method_equations.note: 둘을 합쳐 보고할 때도 각각을 따로 적는다. 규제(IMO)는 WtW로, 우리 모사는 TtW만 계산한다.

method_equations.name: 인벤토리 정규화 (기능단위당)
method_equations.symbols: ṁ_i 흐름 i의 질량유량, P_net 순출력
method_equations.note: 모든 흐름(연료, CO₂, N₂O, NOx, NH₃ 슬립, 물, 전력)을 같은 기준으로 환산한다.

method_equations.name: 상류 배출
method_equations.note: 회색 0.148 … 핑크 0.00565 kg CO₂-eq/MJ로 25배 차이가 난다. 단일값으로 고정하면 결론이 그 선택에 끌려간다 — 시나리오 축으로 둔다.

method_equations.name: 선내 배출의 특성화
method_equations.source: 계수 출처 미정 — 쓰는 판본을 명시할 것
method_equations.note: 암모니아 엔진은 N₂O가 결과를 좌우한다. 계수 판본에 따라 값이 달라지므로 AR5인지 AR6인지 반드시 적는다. 이 저장소에는 아직 계수를 넣지 않았다.

method_equations.name: 다른 영향범주
method_equations.symbols: c: 산성화, 부영양화 등 / CF: 특성화 계수
method_equations.note: 암모니아 슬립과 NOx는 GWP보다 산성화·부영양화에서 더 크게 나타난다. 두 방법 모두 지역화 계수를 쓰므로 어느 지역을 가정했는지 적어야 한다.

method_equations.name: 배분 (부산물이 있을 때)
method_equations.eq: 에너지 배분: A_전력 = E_전력 / (E_전력 + Q_열)  또는 시스템 확장
method_equations.note: 열을 부산물로 계상하면 전력의 부담이 줄어 효율이 좋아 보인다. 배분 방식을 케이스마다 바꾸지 않는다.

method_equations.name: 불확실성
method_equations.eq: 몬테카를로: 입력 분포 → 결과 분포 (상류 강도, 가격, 효율, 배출계수)
method_equations.note: 이미 분포를 갖고 있다 — 스윕 표본의 값들과 상류 배출강도 범위. 점추정만 제시하는 것보다 이 범위를 그대로 반영하는 편이 설득력 있다.
